quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 24,088,363,284.95 (RMB 240.88 hundred million), up 136.26% year over year, mainly on sales growth; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 10,576,875,808.95 (RMB 105.77 hundred million), up 71,528.66%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 10,047,374,676.56, up 31,096.33%; operating cost RMB 9,899,767,031.09, up 11.55%. The company says H1 revenue was the highest for any comparable period since its listing.

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 storage products revenue RMB 23,976,629,588.10 (up 136.13%) at a 59.08% gross margin, up 45.80 points year over year; overseas revenue RMB 17,017,463,787.23 (up 142.27%, gross margin 57.60%), domestic RMB 7,070,899,497.72 (up 122.95%, gross margin 62.04%). The company says revenue and net profit of its Hong Kong subsidiary and Zilia rose mainly because the storage upcycle sharply raised storage product selling prices and gross margins.

H1 2026: enterprise storage revenue reached RMB 21.40 hundred million, up 208.80%; enterprise products have been introduced into the supply chains of some leading internet companies and server makers. Zilia's external sales revenue RMB 39.50 hundred million, up 184.58%; Lexar global sales revenue RMB 39.66 hundred million, up 84.90%.

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: as of the report date its self-designed controller chips have reached cumulative production of over 2.8 hundred million units; UFS 4.1 products carrying its self-developed 5nm UFS 4.1 controller are in volume shipment and have reached scaled commercial application.
quarterly_data.figure: over 2.8 hundred million controller chips produced cumulatively

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 product launches: AILPBGA, a 256-bit single-package LPDDR-interface memory with bandwidth up to 307GB/s, 24GB-64GB capacity and a 22x22mm BGA1764 package, for AI inference and edge large-model devices; and an automotive-grade UFS 4.1 with its self-developed 5nm controller (sequential read up to 4200MB/s, write up to 4000MB/s, 128GB to 512GB), which has entered introduction and validation at leading automakers.
quarterly_data.figure: AILPBGA up to 307GB/s; automotive UFS 4.1 up to 4200MB/s read

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 R&D spending RMB 851,431,666.36, up 91.02%, mainly on pay and benefits, R&D materials and share-based payment; 1,294 R&D staff at June 30, 2026. The raised-fund small-capacity flash memory chip design project was completed in June 2026; it has developed several SLC NAND flash chips from 192Mb to 8Gb.
